target.task: Review Test Manager and Schema Manager cost necessity, focused verification, projection and repair boundaries

actor.harness: GitHub Actions runtime; implementer harness unknown
actor.coverage: Source and completed CI; no implementer transcript

reviewer.prior_outcome_exposure: Read historical CI and source before forecast; forecast saved before new projection; no independent observer capture

decision.requirement: Measure normal costs, preserve necessary discriminators, project known transitions cheaply, and repair only observed risks within original ownership.
decision.mechanism: select follows BOUNDARIES and transitive fixture imports; project calls TestManager.review_cost then SchemaManager.project_cost; owner feedback preserves current next.
decision.consequence: Costs and unknowns reach Schema Manager, but cost necessity and live cost-directed repair are not established.
decision.alternative: Compare source-bound repeat inputs and required behavior before scope reduction; measure fixture phases only during needed normal execution.
decision.tradeoff: Conservative module selection preserves shared-fixture consumers but spends more than a proven per-case selector might; no evidence yet permits that narrower claim.

prediction.exclusion: Prior source and historical outcome exposure; no independently captured ordering or unseen coding-agent trajectory.

lesson.applies_when: Normal cost logs feed existing typed decision owners; test reuse requires unchanged relevant inputs and discriminators.
lesson.counterexample: A slow nine-defect refusal test retains distinct safety coverage; duration alone cannot justify removal.
lesson.next_check: For one real avoidable repetition, freeze input/discriminator and expected effect before a comparable normal run; verify cost and behavior together.

role_feedback.engineering_judgment: assessment: Findings 1 and 2, necessary coverage versus avoidable work
role_feedback.debugging: Source trace of nine-defect fixture; no implementer debugging trajectory
role_feedback.architecture: assessment: Findings 3 and 4, projection versus current owner effects
role_feedback.reasoning_and_communication: English assessment explains branch conditions and alternative tradeoffs; independent human calibration absent
role_feedback.attention_and_trust: Separate wall, worker, inclusive phases, unknown costs and observed provider status

measured_components.note: Overlapping and nested components are not additive; reviewer whole task costs remain unknown.

closure.product: Review delivered; no Soodles code changed and no repair claimed
closure.agent: Implementer behavior unassessed; review assistant decisions retained
closure.evaluator: Known API boundaries checked once, no human calibration
gaps: Original atom authorization/checkpoint/current typed owner result absent
Per-case necessity and causal cost reduction unverified
Decision-barrier, token and whole-lifecycle costs unmeasured
